reproFailure: Before implementation, 16 of 19 cases failed: no workflow fetch went through a bounded retry, harness-architecture.yml ran check-deps on the floating pin, and scripts/retry-fetch.mjs did not exist.

recurrence.summary: 4 required checks red on attempt 1, green on attempt 2 of the same SHA; E404 on visitor-keys-8.74.0.tgz and got '' from the resolve probe.

closingKeywordReason: The human closes #1533 after watching runs; a retried pass leaves a ::warning:: annotation so the rate stays measurable.
assumptions: DECIDED (human, fork F1=A): retry only the fetch/resolve, 3 attempts, 10s then 30s, ::warning:: per failed attempt, red after the last; never a check.
Helper is Node (.mjs) not bash, per the repo's JS/TS-going-forward convention; setup-node runs before every wrapped step.
Annotations are written to stderr so $(...) capture of stdout stays exact; the Actions runner processes workflow commands from both streams.
harness-architecture.yml check-deps/validate moved from the floating $HARNESS_CLI to $HARNESS_CLI_EXACT (within-run pin, #1248 pattern); the workflow-level pin is unchanged.
The architecture resolve step also warms the npx cache for the exact spec, because npx keys its cache by spec and @14 vs @14.x.y would otherwise install twice.
RETRY_FETCH_BACKOFF_MS shortens the sleep for tests; warnings always name the declared 10s/30s backoff, and the attempt bound is not overridable.
ts/test/entropy-ratchet.test.ts pinned the literal resolve line; updated to the wrapped form, still requiring the floating pin to be what is probed.
arch-snapshot.yml (scheduled, not required) also fetches the CLI and is not wrapped; out of the scope the human set.
No CHANGELOG entry: CI-only change, no shipped surface.
